outlets.name: byFood (byfood.com)
outlets.credible: Tokyo-based Japan food platform with a staffed editorial blog and partnerships with recognised experts (e.g. Ramen Adventures' Brian MacDuckston); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Good Luck Trip (gltjp.com)
outlets.credible: Inbound Japan travel guide published by JTB-affiliated Good Luck Trip Inc.; already in the registry; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Culture Trip
outlets.credible: International travel editorial; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: MAPPLE (Shobunsha)
outlets.credible: Shobunsha's Mapple — one of Japan's two major guidebook publishers (cf. Rurubu); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Serai (Shogakukan)
outlets.credible: Shogakukan's long-running lifestyle/travel magazine; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Walkerplus (KADOKAWA)
outlets.credible: KADOKAWA's Walker city-magazine network (Kansai Walker/Kyoto Walker); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Rurubu (JTB Publishing, rurubu.jp)
outlets.credible: JTB Publishing's Rurubu — Japan's best-selling travel guidebook series; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: co-trip (Shobunsha)
outlets.credible: Shobunsha's co-trip guide series; same publisher as MAPPLE, so never paired with MAPPLE as the two sources for one place.

outlets.name: Wa-raku / intojapanwaraku (Shogakukan)
outlets.credible: Shogakukan's Japanese-culture magazine Wa-raku; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Keihan Electric Railway — Kyoto navi
outlets.credible: Official sightseeing pages of the Keihan railway (Kyoto–Osaka operator); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Vogue Hong Kong
outlets.credible: Condé Nast's Vogue Hong Kong edition — international magazine travel/food feature; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Kanpai (kanpai-japan.com)
outlets.credible: Long-running French/English Japan travel guide written by residents since 2008; one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Pearl (joinpearl.co)
outlets.credible: Restaurant guide aggregating award recognitions (Tabelog Hyakumeiten, Michelin); used only as one corroborating source, for the award it records.

outlets.name: Umi no Kyoto (uminokyoto.jp) — Kyoto Prefecture northern tourism DMO
outlets.credible: Official destination-marketing organisation for northern Kyoto Prefecture (Amanohashidate, Ine, Tango); official tourism board, one source.
